body: PRE-CANDIDATE SHAPE SWEEP: two more LIVE open-world consumers have the same Unranked conflation, with the opposite (penalizing) direction. metrics.scala externalSubtype currently does g.externalSubtype.map(expected => ind(row.argmax.contains(External(expected)))); on an exclusively Unranked row, an eligible Association/Intrusion/Inference unit becomes Observed(0.0) — our inability to rank is scored as the participant having the wrong subtype. inferenceMass likewise returns row.mass(SourceConsistentInference)=0.0 for Inference gold on an Unranked row — provider abstention becomes evidence of no inferential content. Both are produced by Metrics.observe, story-macro aggregated, and rendered; inference untouched. These are not speculative call-graph siblings. Under ADR 0003, externalSubtype is a hard classification that must abstain, and inferenceMass is an eligible measurement missing its support; both should emit Missing(ProviderAbstained), not zero. They bias downward rather than flattering, but correlate with the same sparse/disorganised recall. RECOMMEND broadening this bead’s acceptance to all three open-world metrics while the ratified MetricObservation carrier is in hand; same production/test paths, no new vocabulary. Alternative is file two immediate P1s and land externalRule alone. I have not expanded the edit pending chief ruling. Current externalRule candidate 8795e98 is otherwise exact-gated: 47/47, scalafmt, compileAll, both mutants red.
